resolutions.researcher_notes: Brief flagged the current_ref (almasryalyoum) as DEAD_LINK, but re-fetching it now returns HTTP 200 with the full article body live (site was evidently down/blocked at brief-generation time, not permanently dead) -- re-verified and re-used. Al-Masry Al-Youm, 2010-12-29, 'Mubarak yaftah khat ghaz al-Sa'id fi Aswan al-khamis' [Mubarak inaugurates the Upper Egypt gas line in Aswan on Thursday], reports Petroleum Minister Sameh Fahmy touring Aswan ahead of President Mubarak's inauguration of the pipeline -- directly supports operating/completed status. Independent corroboration: The Australian Pipeliner (24 Aug 2020 retrospective, citing Fahmy) confirms the project was completed/commissioned, with the final Sohag-Aswan stage described as commissioned in late 2010. Petroleumafrica.com carries the same Mubarak-inauguration story (not used as a 3rd ref here since it appears to derive from the same ministry statement as the Pipeliner piece, but corroborates independently of almasryalyoum). Two independent origins (Egyptian daily + Australian trade press) => high tier.

Article body (not just the headline/meta) states verbatim: 'wa tamtad al-marhala al-khamisa min Asyut hatta Girga bi-tul 121 km wa qutr 32 bousa' [the fifth phase extends from Asyut to Girga with a length of 121 km and a diameter of 32 inches] -- exact match to the GEM value (121.00 km) and this is very likely the article GEM's own footnote sourced the number from. Verified live (200, contains '121' and 'جرجا'). Sought a second independent source for the exact 121 km figure: The Australian Pipeliner / Petroleum Africa describe the project's own 5-stage breakdown (Cairo-Beni Suef; Beni Suef-Abu Qurqas 150km; Minya-Assiut 136km; Assiut-Sohag 100km; Sohag-Aswan 408km, total ~930km) -- a DIFFERENT segmentation (stage boundary at Sohag, not Girga) that does not independently confirm the 121km Asyut-Girga figure. Flagging this as a genuine segmentation discrepancy between sources (not a value contradiction on the same segment) for a human reviewer -- GEM's finer 6-segment breakdown (...-Asyut / Asyut-Girga 121km / Girga-Aswan 390km) vs. press's coarser 5-stage breakdown (...-Assiut / Assiut-Sohag 100km / Sohag-Aswan 408km) sum to slightly different totals (511km vs 508km for the Asyut-Aswan portion) -- could reflect different route surveys/vintages or different stage-naming conventions, not necessarily an error. No second source found stating a length for an Asyut-Girga (vs Assiut-Sohag) segment specifically, so tier is medium (single strong primary-quote source) rather than high.

Almasryalyoum article names Asyut and Girga explicitly as the two endpoints of the fifth-phase segment (see Length note for the exact quote), supporting StartLocation=Asyut / EndLocation=Girga / both CountryOrArea=Egypt. Asyut governorate/city identity is uncontested. For EndState/Province=Sohag (Girga's governorate, since Girga town itself is not a governorate capital), corroborated with en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Girga, which states Girga administratively belongs to Sohag Governorate -- verified live, contains 'Sohag'. Used as a supplementary geography reference (not project-specific reporting) since no additional pipeline-specific source discusses the Girga endpoint by name; tier medium given one primary project source + one general-geography tertiary source rather than two independent project-reporting sources.
